table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname = 
		CASE item.printable
		WHEN 1 THEN
			CASE SaleOrderDetail.SaleItemDescription 
			WHEN NULL THEN item.name 
			WHEN '' THEN item.name 
			ELSE SaleOrderDetail.SaleItemDescription  END 
		ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END,   
	SaleItemDescription = SaleOrderDetail.SaleItemDescription,
	SizeDescription = item.SizeDescription,
	Batch = SaleOrderDetail.Batch,
	ManfDate = SaleOrderDetail.ManfDate,
	Expiry = SaleOrderDetail.Expiry,
	aliasname=item.customicode,   
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,   
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	custalias=dbo.accounts.aliasname,
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,   
	custcity= dbo.customer.city,
	custcountry= dbo.customer.country,
	bank=dbo.customer.bankname,
	bankadd=dbo.customer.bankadd,
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	SaleOrderCode = dbo.SaleOrderHeader.SaleOrderCode,   
	OrderCode = dbo.SaleOrderHeader.OrderCode,
	SaleOrderCategory = SaleOrderCategory.Name,
	headerno = dbo.SaleOrderHeader.headerno,
	date = dbo.SaleOrderHeader.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.SaleOrderHeader.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.SaleOrderHeader.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.SaleOrderHeader.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = 0.00,   
	gcode = SaleOrderDetail.gcode,   
	icode = SaleOrderDetail.icode,   
	looseqty = SaleOrderDetail.looseqty,
	bonusqty = SaleOrderDetail.bonusqty,   
	packunits= SaleOrderDetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= SaleOrderDetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = SaleOrderDetail.discperc,  
	itemflatdisc=SaleOrderDetail.itemflatdisc,   
	salestax = 0.00,   
	Id = dbo.SaleOrderDetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	posted=SaleOrderHeader.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = SaleOrderDetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = SaleOrderDetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = SaleOrderHeader.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	dbo.SaleOrderHeader.custrefno,
	dbo.SaleOrderHeader.remarks,
	serverdate=getdate(),
	custcode=dbo.SaleOrderHeader.custcode,
	salesperson=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=SaleOrderHeader.smancode),
	messages=(select description from message where messagecode=SaleOrderHeader.messagecode),
	itempacking=(select name from itempacking where itempacking.packcode=item.packcode),
	itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=item.icatcode)
FROM 
	SaleOrderHeader,   
	SaleOrderDetail,   
	SaleOrderCategory,
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item,
	itemcategory,
	itemclass,
	itempacking,
	genericitem
WHERE 
	( dbo.SaleOrderHeader.SaleOrderCode = :ar_SaleOrderCode ) AND 
	( dbo.SaleOrderHeader.SaleOrderCode = dbo.SaleOrderDetail.SaleOrderCode) AND 
	( dbo.SaleOrderHeader.SOCatCode = SaleOrderCategory.SOCatCode ) AND 
	( dbo.SaleOrderHeader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.SaleOrderHeader.usercode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
	( dbo.SaleOrderDetail.icode = dbo.item.icode) AND 
	( dbo.item.icatcode = dbo.itemcategory.icatcode ) AND 
	( dbo.item.iccode = dbo.itemclass.iccode ) AND 
	( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode ) AND 
	( dbo.item.genericcode = dbo.genericitem.genericcode )
ORDER BY 
	dbo.SaleOrderDetail.SaleOrderCode,
	dbo.itemcategory.icatcode,
	dbo.genericitem.name,
	dbo.itemclass.numericalfactor,
	dbo.itemclass.name,
	dbo.itempacking.numericalfactor,
	dbo.itempacking.name

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: /* sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all) */
